title: ‘Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration’: Here’s How to Watch the TV Special Online for Free
summary: Filmed at Disneyland, the largest gathering of Disney Princess stars perform during The Wonderful World of Disney on Aug. 16.
contentText:

To kick off D23 2026 this weekend, Disney brought together the original singing voices of several beloved Disney Princesses — including Jodi Benson (Ariel in The Little Mermaid ), Paige O’Hara (Belle in Beauty and the Beast ), Auli’i Cravalho ( Moana ) and Lea Salonga (Jasmine in Aladdin ) — for a concert titled Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration .

The TV special was filmed at Disneyland in Anaheim, California, and broadcasts on Sunday (Aug. 16).

How to Watch ‘Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration’ Online, At a Glance:

- Date: Sunday, Aug. 16

- Start Time: 8 p.m. ET/PT

- Streaming Platform: DirecTV , Disney+ , Sling , Fubo and Hulu + Live TV

Watch on DirecTV for free

What Time Is ‘Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration’ ?

Disney Princess airs on Sunday (Aug. 16) at 8 p.m. ET/PT. The Wonderful World of Disney TV special broadcasts on ABC, Disney Channel and Freeform, while it streams on Disney+.

A royal invitation awaits! ✨ Watch Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration this Sunday at 8/7c on ABC. Stream on Disney+. pic.twitter.com/rs7MFAR3HS

Who Is Performing During ‘Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration’ ?

For the TV concert, Jodi Benson, Paige O’Hara, Auli’i Cravalho, Brandy, Halle Bailey, Lea Salonga and others are all set to perform.

Where to Watch ‘Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration’ Online for Free

If you’re a Disney fan and cord-cutter, then there are a number of ways to watch Disney Princess without cable, especially if you want to watch for free. For example: DirecTV offers a five-day free trial to try out the streaming service, while others like Fubo and Hulu + Live TV offer free trials too, so you can watch without spending money up front.

'Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration'

Get Disney+

Get Disney+ and Hulu plans starting at $9.99 per month.

Disney+ plans start at $7.99 per month for the ad-supported plan, while you can go ad-free for $13.99 per month. For even more content, Disney+ offers a bundle with Disney+ and Hulu, which starts at $9.99 per month. You can add ESPN Unlimited to Disney+ and Hulu starting at $35.99 per month.

Unfortunately, Disney+ doesn’t come with a free trial anymore, but there’s a clever workaround to get access to the service for free — thanks to DirecTV and Hulu + Live TV . Meanwhile, if you’re not into ESPN Unlimited, you can add HBO Max to Disney+ and Hulu instead with prices starting at $19.99 per month.

Get 3-day free trial

Comes with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited.

The broadcast network ABC, Disney Channel and Freeform are available to watch with Hulu + Live TV too. Prices for the cable alternative start at $89.99 per month, while each plan comes with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited at no additional cost. Hulu + Live TV might be best for those who want all of these streaming services together in one package. It also features many other networks, like CBS, NBC, FOX, BET, CMT, ESPN, Hallmark Channel and more.

Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration broadcasts on ABC, Disney Channel and Freeform on Sunday (Aug. 16) at 8 p.m. ET/PT. One of the best ways to watch the TV special, as part of The Wonderful World of Disney , is with DirecTV , Disney+ and Hulu + Live TV .
